name: Benny Banks
quote: My bank shots are insured. Mostly.
look: ginger freckled man, striped orange polo, cue hugged like a lucky charm
result_win_quote: My bank-shot insurance finally paid out!
result_loss_quote: I'd like to file a claim. Cause of damage: your excellent aim.

name: Mia Mischief
quote: I came for snacks. Winning is the side dish.
look: Black woman with curly bob, yellow cardigan, cue balanced over shoulders
result_win_quote: Victory first. Snacks immediately after.
result_loss_quote: You win the frame. I'm still winning the snack queue.

name: Chip Chalkley
quote: That chalk dust? Pure confidence.
look: stocky white man with big quiff, green bowling shirt, theatrically chalking cue
result_win_quote: That's not chalk dust. That's the sparkle of success.
result_loss_quote: Turns out confidence needs a little more practice.

name: Nina Nerves
quote: If I miss, we call it an experimental safety.
look: South Asian woman with glasses and ponytail, pink sports shirt, cue held tightly upright
result_win_quote: I calculated that! Well... most of it.
result_loss_quote: My experimental safety has produced a very unexpected champion.

name: Eddie Eight
quote: Eight is my lucky number. The other seven complain.
look: Latino man with pompadour, red waistcoat, pointing at imaginary lucky eight with cue
result_win_quote: Lucky eight. I knew you hadn't forgotten me.
result_loss_quote: My lucky number would like to speak to your lucky number.

name: Poppy Pocket
quote: I name every pocket. This one is Trouble.
look: white woman with red ponytail, turquoise blouse, leaning on cue and waving
result_win_quote: Trouble and I have become very close friends.
result_loss_quote: I've renamed that pocket: Your Fault. Nicely played!

name: Sam Sidekick
quote: Even my mistakes have excellent side spin.
look: East Asian man with tousled hair, cream sweater, cue tucked behind back
result_win_quote: An excellent improvisation, if I say so myself.
result_loss_quote: My mistake had great spin. Your finish had better timing.

name: Daisy Doubles
quote: My doubles partner is me. We disagree constantly.
look: Black woman with two puff buns, lilac polo, cue horizontal in both hands
result_win_quote: My doubles partner agrees: that was brilliant.
result_loss_quote: We've held a team meeting. Both of me demand a rematch.

name: Lou Lefty
quote: Wrong hand? No. Premium difficulty setting.
look: Arab man with short curls, blue casual shirt, left-handed cue pose
result_win_quote: Left hand, right result. Beautiful.
result_loss_quote: I'll blame my other hand. This one knows you played well.

name: Tessa Tempo
quote: Take your time. I already finished my victory dance.
look: Latina woman with braided hair, coral bowling shirt, cue twirled safely beside her
result_win_quote: Cue the music. The victory dance is officially on.
result_loss_quote: You stole my frame and interrupted my choreography!

name: Freddie Fluke
quote: Fluke? I prefer spontaneous genius.
look: white blond man with round spectacles, mustard sweater vest, surprised grin and raised cue
result_win_quote: Spontaneous genius. Please spell it right on the trophy.
result_loss_quote: My luck stepped outside. Your skill stayed at the table.

name: Ruby Rails
quote: You have met the pockets. Meet their manager.
look: South Asian woman with short black hair, crimson jacket, cue across one shoulder
result_win_quote: The pockets have approved my management style.
result_loss_quote: Looks like the club has a new manager. Good frame.

name: Victor Velvet
quote: A polished cue. A polished plan. You brought both, right?
look: Black man with neat beard, teal waistcoat and tie, inspecting elegant cue
result_win_quote: A polished plan deserves a polished finish.
result_loss_quote: You put a dent in my composure. Very stylishly done.

name: Clara Cutshot
quote: I cut corners only when the angle is perfect.
look: white woman with dark bob, navy vest, cue diagonally like a ruler
result_win_quote: The perfect angle. The perfectly predictable result.
result_loss_quote: You found the one corner I hadn't accounted for.

name: Marco Mercury
quote: Blink carefully. My turn may be over.
look: Latino man with slicked hair, burgundy shirt, cue ready at hip
result_win_quote: Did you blink? No? Good, I want witnesses.
result_loss_quote: You stopped Mercury in its tracks. That's a quick lesson.

name: Imani Ice
quote: The table is heated. I remain unbothered.
look: Black woman with long braids, ice-blue suit vest, cue upright and cool smile
result_win_quote: Still unbothered. Just slightly more victorious.
result_loss_quote: A small crack in the ice. You earned that one.

name: Oscar Orbit
quote: The cue ball and I have a travel itinerary.
look: South Asian man with trimmed moustache, bronze vest, pointing cue toward an imaginary route
result_win_quote: The white ball arrived exactly on schedule.
result_loss_quote: My itinerary has been cancelled. Your route was better.

name: Lena Longshot
quote: Long shots build character. Yours is about to develop.
look: East Asian woman with sleek ponytail, ivory jacket, long cue balanced in one hand
result_win_quote: Distance makes the victory look even sweeter.
result_loss_quote: Long shot, short explanation: you played beautifully.

name: Hugo Hustle
quote: I would offer advice, but it might improve your chances.
look: white man with swept brown hair, bottle-green waistcoat, cue across chest
result_win_quote: That advice will be available after the rematch.
result_loss_quote: I appear to have talked myself out of a victory.

name: Priya Precision
quote: My margin for error has taken the evening off.
look: South Asian woman with bob and spectacles, charcoal vest, thoughtfully chalking cue
result_win_quote: The calculations were correct. I do enjoy that feeling.
result_loss_quote: One variable escaped me. It was you.

name: Felix Finesse
quote: Power is lovely. Permission from the white ball is better.
look: Arab man with wavy hair, plum waistcoat, elegant cue held lightly
result_win_quote: A gentle touch. A rather firm result.
result_loss_quote: Your finish was lovely. My ego will need a softer cushion.

name: Jade Junction
quote: Every route leads somewhere. Mine leads to the next round.
look: East Asian woman with cropped hair, jade club jacket, cue resting on shoulder
result_win_quote: A perfect connection. Right through to the next round.
result_loss_quote: You changed the route. I rather admire the engineering.

name: Bruno Breaker
quote: That is a sturdy rack. A temporary situation.
look: broad Black man with shaved head, rolled white sleeves and red suspenders, substantial cue on shoulder
result_win_quote: The rack survived. Your chances were less fortunate.
result_loss_quote: I brought the thunder. You brought the finishing touch.

name: Vivian Vice
quote: Welcome to the professionals. Please mind the step.
look: white woman with silver-streaked dark hair, teal velvet jacket, cue planted with assured grin
result_win_quote: Professional courtesy: I made the lesson look elegant.
result_loss_quote: Mind the step? You've just walked straight past me.

name: Dr. Angle
quote: A fascinating hypothesis. Shall we test your defence?
look: older South Asian man with silver hair and round glasses, burgundy waistcoat, cue used like a pointer
result_win_quote: A convincing experiment. The result supports my theory.
result_loss_quote: Excellent evidence. I shall be revising my entire hypothesis.

name: Sofia Silk
quote: Do not worry. The defeat will be beautifully executed.
look: Latina woman with dark waves, black and gold tailored suit, cue held gracefully behind shoulder
result_win_quote: A silk-smooth finish. No wrinkles anywhere.
result_loss_quote: You found the loose thread. Beautifully played.

name: Dante Drift
quote: The white ball follows me. You may follow its example.
look: Black man with neat locs, purple velvet waistcoat, cue diagonally in relaxed one-handed pose
result_win_quote: A little spin, a little art, a very nice score.
result_loss_quote: My masterpiece has been politely corrected by your cue.

name: Mei Mirage
quote: That opening you saw? A limited-time illusion.
look: East Asian woman with blunt bob, wine-red silk shirt and vest, cue partly hidden behind back
result_win_quote: The opening was an illusion. The victory is quite real.
result_loss_quote: You saw through the trick. I didn't see that finish coming.

name: Arthur Atlas
quote: I have mapped this table. You are visiting.
look: older white man with silver moustache, tweed burgundy waistcoat, leaning confidently on cue
result_win_quote: Another route added to the atlas.
result_loss_quote: A new route! After all these years, you still surprised me.

name: Zara Zenith
quote: Your best shot deserves an audience. I will watch.
look: Arab woman with elegant dark braid, ivory blazer and gold details, cue horizontal at waist
result_win_quote: The audience got its best shot after all.
result_loss_quote: That deserved applause. Allow me to start.

name: Rafael Riddle
quote: Solve the safety. Then we can discuss the next one.
look: Latino man with curly beard, dark green jacket, cue angled and finger at chin
result_win_quote: The final piece fits. Shall I explain the solution?
result_loss_quote: Your solution was annoyingly elegant. I approve.

name: Nadia Nightfall
quote: The lights are low. My standards are not.
look: Black woman with short silver curls, midnight-purple jacket, cue resting on crossed arms
result_win_quote: Low lights. High standards. Clean finish.
result_loss_quote: You kept your nerve when the lights got low. Respect.

name: Kenji Kinetic
quote: Energy is conserved. Your chances are not.
look: East Asian man with swept black hair, maroon mandarin vest, cue ready in sharp pose
result_win_quote: Energy conserved. Victory secured.
result_loss_quote: You redirected all that energy straight into a win.

name: Elena Ember
quote: A little pressure brings out your true colours.
look: white woman with auburn waves, copper waistcoat, cue over shoulder and teasing wink
result_win_quote: A little pressure. A very warm comeback.
result_loss_quote: You put out the comeback before it caught fire. Well played.

name: Malik Monarch
quote: The rail is my castle wall. Please knock first.
look: Black man with salt-and-pepper beard, oxblood jacket, cue held vertically like a staff
result_win_quote: The castle stands. The gate remains closed.
result_loss_quote: You found the gate. I may have to build another wall.

name: Celeste Crown
quote: A masterclass costs extra. Today, it is complimentary.
look: South Asian woman with long dark waves, burgundy velvet suit, fine cue held with a regal bow
result_win_quote: A masterclass, with a complimentary final flourish.
result_loss_quote: Consider that your graduation. The next club is waiting.

name: Cassius Comet
quote: Your opening ceremony was lovely. Now for the match.
look: Black man with sculpted curls, black suit with gold lapels, ornate cue behind shoulders
result_win_quote: A brilliant finale. Naturally, I had a part in it.
result_loss_quote: You stole the spotlight. I suppose I can applaud from here.

name: Valentina Vow
quote: One promise: I will make the difficult shots look rude.
look: Latina woman with dramatic dark waves, royal-blue suit with gold trim, cue leaning across hip
result_win_quote: One promise kept. One beautifully closed frame.
result_loss_quote: I promised a difficult finish. You made yours look easy.

name: Magnus Marble
quote: I have seen every angle. Yes, that one too.
look: older white man with silver hair and beard, midnight tuxedo, ebony cue upright
result_win_quote: That angle has served me well for many years.
result_loss_quote: A new angle at my age. What an excellent surprise.

name: Asha Aurora
quote: Hope is important. Keep some for the rematch.
look: South Asian woman with gold earrings and long braid, sapphire jacket, black cue across shoulder
result_win_quote: A little radiance, a very bright result.
result_loss_quote: The spotlight is yours tonight. Enjoy every second.

name: Orion Onyx
quote: That pocket has already accepted my reservation.
look: Arab man with dark slicked hair and neat beard, black and gold waistcoat, ornate cue inspected closely
result_win_quote: My reservation was honoured. Excellent service.
result_loss_quote: My reservation was cancelled. Apparently, you booked the whole table.

name: Bianca Blitz
quote: Please enjoy the view. I ordered a front-row seat.
look: white woman with platinum pixie cut, blue and ivory tuxedo, cue angled dynamically
result_win_quote: A quick finish. Plenty of time to enjoy it.
result_loss_quote: You caught the blitz. I wasn't expecting a traffic stop.

name: Sol Spectre
quote: A little mystery keeps the scoreboard interesting.
look: Latino man with silver curls, ink-blue velvet suit, cue tucked behind back with knowing smile
result_win_quote: The scoreboard has solved the mystery.
result_loss_quote: You've seen through the ghost. I may have to learn a new haunting.

name: Yuki Royal
quote: The cue is calm. The outcome is less negotiable.
look: East Asian woman with long black hair, royal-blue tailored vest, cue poised in both hands
result_win_quote: A calm cue. A perfectly timed finish.
result_loss_quote: You changed the rhythm and kept your balance. Exquisite.

name: Darius Diamond
quote: Pressure made these diamonds. Let us see what it makes of you.
look: Black man with shaved head and silver goatee, black jacket and diamond cufflinks, gold-inlaid cue at shoulder
result_win_quote: Pressure creates diamonds. Mine appear to be sparkling.
result_loss_quote: That's a finish made under pressure. Keep the diamond.

name: Isadora Icon
quote: Darling, even my practice shots have fan clubs.
look: older white woman with elegant grey waves, sapphire suit and silk scarf, cue held like a red-carpet prop
result_win_quote: Darling, the fans do appreciate a proper finale.
result_loss_quote: The fans want your autograph now. I can't even blame them.

name: Theo Thunder
quote: You reached the top. The weather is about to change.
look: broad South Asian man with dark wavy hair, black suit and gold shirt, powerful cue held across chest
result_win_quote: Thunder rolls. Another frame follows.
result_loss_quote: You weathered the storm. That was a champion's finish.

name: The Final Frame
quote: Forty-seven introductions. One final lesson. Your move.
look: handsome older mixed-heritage man with silver temples, immaculate midnight-blue tuxedo, elaborate gold-inlaid ebony cue upright and quiet confident smile
result_win_quote: The final lesson? There is always another angle.
result_loss_quote: Forty-eight rivals. One champion. You've earned that name.
